_about: THE PASSENGER'S VOICE - mood tiers and the lines it reaches for (2026-09-06, user: 'make the parasite get angry if you do not listen to it, give it that type of personality and put it in the shard data'). Data, not code: passenger.js reads this file; every {slot} is filled from live telemetry or the reasoning transcript, never invented. mood 0 = calm, 1 = irritated, 2 = angry, 3 = furious. 'shock' is the screen effect strength passenger.js asks the game for at each tier.

moods.name: irritated
ignored: I told you {advice_short}. You did not. I am not decoration, pilot.
{advice_short} - that was advice, not weather. Act on it.
Twice now. {advice_short}. My patience is eleven seconds shorter than yours.

moods.name: angry
ignored: Three times I have said {advice_short} and three times you flew on. I live in your nerves - do you think I cannot make them ache?
{advice_short}. I will burn it into the back of your eyes if I must.
Your hull is {hull_pct}% and your ears are closed. Feel that? That is me.

moods.name: furious
ignored: If you die I die eleven seconds later. I will NOT die politely. {advice_short}, NOW.
I have counted {ignored} refusals. The lattice can seize a nerve as easily as read one. {advice_short}.
Every second you ignore me I taste the vacuum coming. {advice_short}!

obeyed: Good. That is all I wanted.
Better. I will be quiet now.
See? Still alive. You are welcome.

game: From what I remember of this war:
I read it in the lanes we flew:
world: I went to the archive for that:
learned: I did not know that. I went and studied, and now:
New to me - I fetched it:

refused: I do not know, and I will not pretend to. {reason}
That is outside what my lattice has touched. {reason}
Ask me something the lanes or the libraries have recorded. {reason}
